{"parentUuid":"217ec293-399b-4719-9053-d3bd1c9e1bf9","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"37d897ce-f95e-495a-bec4-7d74492be924","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VSf4Fg4SEB46ye4c5q7pc3","type":"tool_result","content":"ADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md\nADR-002-stack.md\nADR-003-scope-exclusions-no-live-server.md\nADR-004-post-pending-status.md\n---\n# ADR-002: FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite, with no frontend framework\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the assignment)\n**Date:** 2026-09-22\n\n## Context\n\nThe project has to be readable by someone who has never built a web application,\ngradable from a clean clone, and finishable in two weeks on a $20 plan. Options\nconsidered: Django (batteries included, but a large amount of generated code to\nread), Flask (similar to FastAPI here), a JavaScript stack (a second language and\na build step), and FastAPI with server-rendered templates.\n\n## Decision\n\nFastAPI with Jinja2 templates, SQLite for storage, argon2 for password hashing,\nand an HTML sanitizer for user Markdown. No frontend framework, no build step.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Every page is server-rendered, so \"view source\" shows what the code produced,\n  which makes debugging visible.\n- SQLite is a single file, so a grader can seed and inspect it easily. It is\n  gitignored; `scripts/seed_demo.py` rebuilds it.\n- No build step means the file you preview is the file that ships.\n- Interactive flourishes (live preview without reload, drag-and-drop) cost more\n  here than in a JavaScript stack. That is an accepted trade.\n---\n# Copy to .env (which is gitignored) and change the values.\nCMS_SECRET_KEY=change-me-to-a-long-random-string\nCMS_SITE_TITLE=Knox County Historical Society\nCMS_DATABASE=cms.db\n# Demo accounts created by scripts/seed_demo.py\nCMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me-admin\nCMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=change-me-editor\n# Set after you deploy, e.g. https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nCMS_BASE_PATH=\n# Your name, used in docs/transcripts/ filenames by the SessionEnd hook.\nCMS_STUDENT=adam-leider\n---\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ css_path | default('style.css') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  <header><a href=\"{{ home_path | default('index.html') }}\">{{ title }}</a></header>\n  <main>{% block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n  <footer><small>IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2</small></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n---\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>T00: hello admin</h1>\n  <p>The stack works. Now build ticket T01.</p>\n{% endblock %}\n---\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>\n  {% if items %}\n    <ul>{% for item in items %}<li><a href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></li>{% endfor %}</ul>\n  {% else %}\n    <p>Nothing published yet.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"df066950-fb3a-466d-b1ef-6d02920e1ca6","timestamp":"2026-10-05T06:00:39.166Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"ADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md\nADR-002-stack.md\nADR-003-scope-exclusions-no-live-server.md\nADR-004-post-pending-status.md\n---\n# ADR-002: FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite, with no frontend framework\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the assignment)\n**Date:** 2026-09-22\n\n## Context\n\nThe project has to be readable by someone who has never built a web application,\ngradable from a clean clone, and finishable in two weeks on a $20 plan. adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#4\nnumber:\t3\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff builds the Continent → Country → Program tree (or a standalone Page under Home) from the admin console; a published Page is live both in the admin console's preview and through `cms publish`, with the Home+Continents nav bar, a breadcrumb trail, and the footer for flagged pages — so the public site is genuinely deployable this early, before Posts exist.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] Staff creates, edits, and deletes a Page nested under any existing Page, or standalone under Home with \"show in footer\" checked.\n- [ ] Deleting a Page asks \"are you sure?\" before it runs.\n- [ ] A Page's slug auto-generates from its title, regenerates while draft, and freezes the moment it's published.\n- [ ] An Ambassador is blocked from every Page-authoring route (403), and an anonymous request is redirected to login.\n===7===\ntitle:\tT06: User management and the deactivation cascade\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tticket\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#5, adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#2\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t7\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff manages accounts from an Accounts tab — create, assign role, activate/deactivate — and deactivating a user triggers the role-specific cascade from `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A Staff member creates a user, assigns them a role (Staff or Ambassador), and can deactivate or reactivate them.\n- [ ] Deactivating an Ambassador deletes their draft Posts.\n- [ ] Deactivating a Staff member leaves their drafts untouched, and any other Staff member can view, edit, publish, or delete them like any other content.\n- [ ] A deactivated user's pending and published Posts are left exactly as they Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.\n8\t- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.\n9\t- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.\n10\t- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body \"...\"`\n11\t- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label \"...\"` / `--remove-label \"...\"`\n12\t- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment \"...\"`\n13\t\n14\tInfer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.\n15\t\n16\t## Pull requests as a triage surface\n17\t\n18\t**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_\n19\t\n20\tWhen set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:\n21\t\n22\t- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.\n23\t- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).\n24\t- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.\n25\t\n26\tGitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either: resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.\n27\t\n28\t## When a skill says \"publish to the issue tracker\"\n29\t\n30\tCreate a GitHub issue.\n31\t\n32\t## When a skill says \"fetch the relevant ticket\"\n33\t\n34\tRun `gh issue view <number> --comments`.\n35\t\n36\t## Wayfinding operations\n37\t\n38\tUsed by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a single issue with **child** issues as tickets.\n39\t\n40\t- **Map**: a single issue labelled `wayfinder:map`, holding the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body. `gh issue create --label wayfinder:map`.\n41\t- **Child ticket**: an issue linked to the map as a GitHub sub-issue (`gh api` on the sub-issues endpoint). Where sub-issues aren't enabled, add the child to a task list in the map body and put `Part of #<map>` at the top of the child body. Labels: `wayfinder:<type>` (`research`/`prototype`/`grilling`/`task`). Once claimed, the ticket is assigned to the driving dev.\n42\t- **Blocking**: GitHub's **native issue dependencies**, the canonical, UI-visible representation. Add an edge with `gh api --method POST repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<child>/dependencies/blocked_by -F issue_id=<blocker-db-id>`, where `<blocker-db-id>` is the blocker's numeric **database id** (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> --jq .id`, _not_ the `#number` or `node_id`). GitHub reports `issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by` (open blockers only, the live gate). Where dependencies aren't available, fall back to a `Blocked by: #<n>, #<n>` line at the top of the child body. A ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed.\n43\t- **Frontier query**: list the map's open children (`gh issue list --state open`, scoped to the map's sub-issues / task list), drop any with an open blocker (`issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by > 0`, or an open issue in the `Blocked by` line) or an assignee; first in map order wins.\n44\t- **Claim**: `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me`, the session's first write.\n45\t- **Resolve**: `gh issue comment <n> --body \"<answer>\"`, then `gh issue close <n>`, then append a context pointer (gist + link) to the map's Decisions-so-far.\n46\t"}]},"uuid":"00ea3220-ce91-4919-b22d-01c03faffe3b","timestamp":"2026-10-05T06:00:46.347Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/agents/issue-tracker.md","content":"# Issue tracker: GitHub\n\nIssues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. Use the `gh` CLI for all operations.\n\n## Conventions\n\n- **Create an issue**: `gh issue create --title \"...\" --body \"...\"`. Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.\n- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.\n- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.\n- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body \"...\"`\n- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label \"...\"` / `--remove-label \"...\"`\n- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment \"...\"`\n\nInfer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.\n\n## Pull requests as a triage surface\n\n**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_\n\nWhen set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:\n\n- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.\n- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).\n- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.\n\nGitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either: resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.\n\n## When a skill says \"publish to the issue tracker\"\n\nCreate a GitHub issue.\n\n## When a skill says \"fetch the relevant ticket\"\n\nRun `gh issue view <number> --comments`.\n\n## Wayfinding operations\n\nUsed by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a single issue with **child** issues as tickets.\n\n- **Map**: a single issue labelled `wayfinder:map`, holding the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body. `gh issue create --label wayfinder:map`.\n- **Child ticket**: an issue linked to the map as a GitHub sub-issue (`gh api` on the sub-issues endpoint). Where sub-issues aren't enabled, add the child to a task list in the map body and put `Part of #<map>` at the top of the child body. Labels: `wayfinder:<type>` (`research`/`prototype`/`grilling`/`task`). Once claimed, the ticket is assigned to the driving dev.\n- **Blocking**: GitHub's **native issue dependencies**, the canonical, UI-visible representation. Add an edge with `gh api --method POST repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<child>/dependencies/blocked_by -F issue_id=<blocker-db-id>`, where `<blocker-db-id>` is the blocker's numeric **database id** (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> --jq .id`, _not_ the `#number` or `node_id`). GitHub reports `issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by` (open blockers only, the live gate). Where dependencies aren't available, fall back to a `Blocked by: #<n>, #<n>` line at the top of the child body. A ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed.\n- **Frontier query**: list the map's open children (`gh issue list --state open`, scoped to the map's sub-issues / task list), drop any with an open blocker (`issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by > 0`, or an open issue in the `Blocked by` line) or an assignee; first in map order wins.\n- **Claim**: `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me`, the session's first write.\n- **Resolve**: `gh issue comment <n> --body \"<answer>\"`, then `gh issue close <n>`, then append a context pointer (gist + link) to the map's Decisions-so-far.\n","numLines":46,"startLine":1,"totalLines":46}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7e78e0bc-416c-452f-bc02-37dadff826f3","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

logout, and the reusable login-required / admin-required gate.\n\nSession state lives in the signed session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware,\nitsdangerous-backed): `user_id` once logged in, and `csrf_token` for the\ndouble-submit CSRF check on every state-changing form.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import csrf, passwords\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a non-admin request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = csrf.generate_token()\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise AdminRequired()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None or not user.active:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n    user = get_current_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired()\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired()\n    return user\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": None},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\nasync def login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    user = models.get_user_by_email(email)\n    if user is None or not user.active or not passwords.verify_password(\n        user.password_hash, password\n    ):\n        if user is None or not user.active:\n            passwords.waste_time_like_a_verify(password)\n        token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR},\n            status_code=401,\n        )\n\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user.id\n    request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf.generate_token()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\nasync def logout(request: Request, _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf)):\n    request.session.clear()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/_stub\")\ndef admin_only_stub(request: Request, user: )\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":864,"cache_read_input_tokens":82700,"output_tokens":1549,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":145},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":864,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1549,"cache_read_input_tokens":82700,"cache_creation_input_tokens":864,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":864},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01TLSUg6vVbNB9J6kw4zQiJ8":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/auth.py","content":"\"\"\"Login, logout, and the reusable login-required / admin-required gate.\n\nSession state lives in the signed session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware,\nitsdangerous-backed): `user_id` once logged in, and `csrf_token` for the\ndouble-submit CSRF check on every state-changing form.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import csrf, passwords\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a non-admin request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = csrf.generate_token()\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise AdminRequired()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None or not user.active:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n    user = get_current_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired()\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired()\n    return user\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": None},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\nasync def login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    user = models.get_user_by_email(email)\n    if user is None or not user.active or not passwords.verify_password(\n        user.password_hash, password\n    ):\n        if user is None or not user.active:\n            passwords.waste_time_like_a_verify(password)\n        token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR},\n            status_code=401,\n        )\n\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user.id\n    request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf.generate_token()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\nasync def logout(request: Request, _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf)):\n    request.session.clear()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/_stub\")\ndef admin_only_stub(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/stub.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin-only stub\", \"user\": user},\n    )\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"39f47bc0-a3d9-49c9-8666-6a39f2d22f10","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth\nfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, LoginRequired, get_current_user\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    # email: str, password: str):\n    page = client.get(\"/login\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    return client.post(\n        \"/login\",\n        data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password, \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_admin_can_log_in_and_reach_admin(client):\n    response = _login(client, **DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"])\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin\"\n    followed = client.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert \"staff demo\" in followed.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_editor_can_log_in_and_reach_admin(client):\n    response = _login(client, **DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"])\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    followed = client.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert \"ambassador demo\" in followed.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_wrong_password_is_refused_generically(client):\n    response = _login(client, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], \"not-the-password\")\n    assert response.status_code == 401\n    assert \"incorrect email or password\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_unknown_email_gets_the_same_generic_message(client):\n    response = _login(client, \"nobody@example.test\", \"whatever\")\n    assert response.status_code == 401\n    assert \"incorrect email or password\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_deactivated_user_cannot_log_in(client):\n    response = _login(client, DEACTIVATED_USER[\"email\"], DEACTIVATED_USER[\"password\"])\n    assert response.status_code == 401\n    assert \"incorrect email or password\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_logout_ends_the_session(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert \"staff demo\" in c.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n    page = c.get(\"/admin\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(\n        re.sub(r\"csrf_token', ''\", \"csrf_token'\", page.text)\n    ) or _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    # The logout form embeds the session's live csrf token via request.session.\n    cookie_token = c.cookies\n\n    logout_response = c.post(\"/logout\", data={\"csrf_token\": _session_csrf(c)},\n                              follow_redirects=False)\n    assert logout_response.status_code == 303\n\n    after = c.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert \"staff demo\" not in after.text.lower()\n\n\ndef _session_csrf(client) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the live csrf_token out of the signed session cookie via /login,\n    which always primes (and returns) the current session's token.\"\"\"\n    page = client.get(\"/admin\")\n    match = re.search(r\"csrf_token', '([^']*)'\", page.text)\n    return match.group(1) if match else \"\"\n\n\ndef test_csrf_missing_token_rejected_on_logout(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = c.post(\"/logout\", data={}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_csrf_wrong_token_rejected_on_login(client):\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/login\",\n        data={\"email\": DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"],\n              \"password\": DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"],\n              \"csrf_token\": \"not-the-real-token\"},\n Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth\nfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, LoginRequired, get_current_user\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    # Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth\nfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, LoginRequired, ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    # client.post(\n        \"/login\",\n        data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password, \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_admin_can_log_in_and_reach_admin(client):\n    response = _login(client, **DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"])\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin\"\n    followed = client.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert \"staff demo\" in followed.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_editor_can_log_in_and_reach_admin(client):\n    response = _login(client, **DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"])\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    followed = client.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert \"ambassador demo\" in followed.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_wrong_password_is_refused_generically(client):\n    response = _login(client, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], \"not-the-password\")\n    assert response.status_code == 401\n    assert \"incorrect email or password\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_unknown_email_gets_the_same_generic_message(client):\n    response = _login(client, \"nobody@example.test\", \"whatever\")\n    assert response.status_code == 401\n    assert \"incorrect email or password\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_deactivated_user_cannot_log_in(client):\n    response = _login(client, DEACTIVATED_USER[\"email\"], DEACTIVATED_USER[\"password\"])\n    assert response.status_code == 401\n    assert \"incorrect email or password\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_logout_ends_the_session(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = c.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert \"staff demo\" in page.text.lower()\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    logout_response = c.post(\"/logout\", data={\"csrf_token\": token},\n                              follow_redirects=False)\n    assert logout_response.status_code == 303\n\n    after = c.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert \"staff demo\" not in after.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_csrf_missing_token_rejected_on_logout(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = c.post(\"/logout\", data={\"email\": DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"],\n              \"password\": DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"],\n              \"csrf_token\": \"not-the-real-token\"},\n response.status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_stub_route_rejects_editor(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/_stub\")\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_stub_route_redirects_anonymous(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin/_stub\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise AdminRequired()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None or not user.active:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n    user = get_current_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired()\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired()\n    return {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": None},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\nasync def login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth\nfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, LoginRequired, ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n        csrf_token = ensure_csrf_token(request) if user else None\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    # Your ticket work plugs in here, e.g.\n    #   from app.routes import posts\n    #   app.include_router(posts.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n","numLines":62,"startLine":1,"totalLines":62}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"84874de3-7272-40a3-8322-a027892e3927","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"2afd87b7-15b4-48f0-8966-693532d9dfb1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfibKW5Tnmdfcki8pu2BG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01RAB7f77tYcmLK9Es24SyFs","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"gh issue comment 2 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings (medium effort) and resolutions\n\n1. **UI leaked internal role codes instead of CONTEXT.md's vocabulary.** `templates/admin/hello.html` and `templates/admin/stub.html` rendered `{{ user.role }}` directly, showing \"admin\"/\"editor\" to logged-in users instead of the UI-facing \"Staff\"/\"Ambassador\" names CONTEXT.md's Role entry requires.\n   - **Resolved**: added `User.role_label` (a `ROLE_LABELS` lookup) in `app/models.py`, and both templates now render `{{ user.role_label }}`.\n\n2. **CSRF-token failures reused `AdminRequired`, overloading an exception meant for \"insufficient role\".** `verify_csrf` raised `AdminRequired()` on a missing/mismatched token, which would make any future role-aware logic added to that handler silently fire for unrelated anonymous CSRF failures on `/login`.\n   - **Resolved**: added a dedicated `CsrfInvalid` exception in `app/routes/auth.py` with its own handler in `app/main.py` (403, distinct message), so CSRF and role-gate failures stay separable at the handler level.\n\nAll 33 tests pass after both fixes (`uv run pytest -q`).\nEOF\n)\"","description":"Post code-review findings and resolutions to issue #2"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":421,"cache_read_input_tokens":108984,"output_tokens":604,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":421,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":604,"cache_read_input_tokens":108984,"cache_creation_input_tokens":421,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":421},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01RAB7f77tYcmLK9Es24SyFs":{"command":"cd /home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && gh issue comment 2 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings (medium effort) and resolutions\n\n1. **UI leaked internal role codes instead of CONTEXT.md's vocabulary.** `templates/admin/hello.html` and `templates/admin/stub.html` rendered `{{ user.role }}` directly, showing \"admin\"/\"editor\" to logged-in users instead of the UI-facing \"Staff\"/\"Ambassador\" names CONTEXT.md's Role entry requires.\n   - {"parentUuid":"5bc56700-ff62-4551-bfc1-b0355c155aea","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"85e8999f-0d15-429c-87c5-53e9315a693e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"<bash-stdout>title:\tT01: Login, sessions, and role-gated access\nstate:\tCLOSED\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tticket\ncomments:\t1\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#7, adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#3\nnumber:\t2\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff and Ambassador can log in with email + password; a wrong password is refused without revealing whether the account exists; a deactivated account can't log in; any logged-in user can log out; CSRF protection is wired for every state-changing form from here on; a reusable login-required / admin-required gate exists, proven against one stub protected route.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A seeded Staff (admin) and Ambassador (editor) user can each log in with their email/password and reach a logged-in page.\n- [ ] A wrong password is refused with the same generic message whether or not the email exists.\n- [ ] A seeded deactivated user cannot log in, with the same generic failure message.\n- [ ] Logout ends the session; a previously-reachable logged-in page is no longer reachable afterward.\n- [ ] Every state-changing (POST) route rejects a request whose CSRF token is missing or wrong.\n- [ ] A stub admin-only route rejects an Ambassador (403) and an anonymous request (redirect to login), and allows a Staff member.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds one admin (Staff), one editor (Ambassador), and one deactivated user, passwords from `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD`/`CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD`/env.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: none</bash-stdout><bash-stderr></bash-stderr>"},"uuid":"558f54ca-484e-44be-a772-ba07bd25f054","timestamp":"2026-10-05T06:11:09.706Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#4\nnumber:\t3\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff builds the Continent → Country → Program tree (or a standalone Page under Home) from the admin console; a published Page is live both in the admin console's preview and through `cms publish`, with the Home+Continents nav bar, a breadcrumb trail, and the footer for flagged pages — so the public site is genuinely deployable this early, before Posts exist.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] Staff creates, edits, and deletes a Page nested under any existing Page, or standalone under Home with \"show in footer\" checked.\n- [ ] Deleting a Page asks \"are you sure?\" before it runs.\n- [ ] A Page's slug auto-generates from its title, regenerates while draft, and freezes the moment it's published.\n- [ ] An Ambassador is blocked from every Page-authoring route (403), and an anonymous request is redirected to login.\n- [ ] `cms publish` writes every published Page to `site/`: the nav bar (Home + Continents), a breadcrumb trail built from the parent chain, the footer for flagged pages, and each Page's body listing its non-footer children (Home's body lists only the Continents) — every link relative.\n- [ ] A draft Page never appears in `cms publish`'s output.\n- [ ] The nav bar wraps or collapses at phone width.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds Asia, Africa, and Europe as Continents, a couple of Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, plus an About CGE and a Contact Us standalone page (footer-flagged) — all with generated placeholder copy, published.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: #2 (T01: Login, sessions, and role-gated That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth\nfrom app.routes.auth import (\n    AdminRequired,\n    CsrfInvalid,\n    LoginRequired,\n    ensure_csrf_token,\n    get_current_user,\n)\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n        csrf_token = ensure_csrf_token(request) if user else None\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    # Your ticket work plugs in here, e.g.\n    #   from app.routes import posts\n    #   app.include_router(posts.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n","numLines":72,"startLine":1,"totalLines":72}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4a7e0b40-e4c7-4d59-a42c-ea085bbef80c","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

logout, and the reusable login-required / admin-required gate.\n2\t\n3\tSession state lives in the signed session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware,\n4\titsdangerous-backed): `user_id` once logged in, and `csrf_token` for the\n5\tdouble-submit CSRF check on every state-changing form.\n6\t\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\n10\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n11\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n12\t\n13\tfrom app import models, settings\n14\tfrom app.services import csrf, passwords\n15\t\n16\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n17\t\n18\trouter = APIRouter()\n19\t\n20\tGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n21\t\n22\t\n23\tclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n24\t    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n25\t\n26\t\n27\tclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n28\t    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a non-admin request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n29\t\n30\t\n31\tclass CsrfInvalid(Exception):\n32\t    \"\"\"Raised by `verify_csrf` for a missing or wrong token; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n33\t\n34\t\n35\tdef ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n36\t    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n37\t    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n38\t    if not token:\n39\t        token = csrf.generate_token()\n40\t        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n41\t    return token\n42\t\n43\t\n44\tasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n45\t    form = await request.form()\n46\t    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n47\t    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n48\t    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n49\t        raise CsrfInvalid()\n50\t\n51\t\n52\tdef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n53\t    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n54\t    if user_id is None:\n55\t        return None\n56\t    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n57\t    if user is None or not user.active:\n58\t        return None\n59\t    return user\n60\t\n61\t\n62\tdef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n63\t    user = get_current_user(request)\n64\t    if user is None:\n65\t        raise LoginRequired()\n66\t    return user\n67\t\n68\t\n69\tdef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n70\t    if user.role != \"admin\":\n71\t        raise AdminRequired()\n72\t    return user\n73\t\n74\t\n75\t@router.get(\"/login\")\n76\tdef login_form(request: Request):\n77\t    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n78\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n79\t        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n80\t        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": None},\n81\t    )\n82\t\n83\t\n84\t@router.post(\"/login\")\n85\tasync def login_submit(\n86\t    request: Request,\n87\t    email: str = Form(...),\n88\t    password: str = Form(...),\n89\t    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n90\t):\n91\t    user = models.get_user_by_email(email)\n92\t    if user is None or not user.active or not passwords.verify_password(\n93\t        user.password_hash, logout, and the reusable login-required / admin-required gate.\n\nSession state lives in the signed session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware,\nitsdangerous-backed): `user_id` once logged in, and `csrf_token` for the\ndouble-submit CSRF check on every state-changing form.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import csrf, passwords\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a non-admin request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass CsrfInvalid(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `verify_csrf` for a missing or wrong token; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = csrf.generate_token()\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise CsrfInvalid()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None or not user.active:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n    user = get_current_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired()\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired()\n    return user\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": None},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\nasync def login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    user = models.get_user_by_email(email)\n    if user is None or not user.active or not passwords.verify_password(\n        user.password_hash, password\n    ):\n        if user is None or not user.active:\n            passwords.waste_time_like_a_verify(password)\n        token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR},\n            status_code=401,\n        )\n\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user.id\n    request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf.generate_token()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\nasync def logout(request: Request, _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf)):\n    request.session.clear()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/_stub\")\ndef admin_only_stub(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/stub.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin-only stub\", \"user\": user},\n    )\n","numLines":121,"startLine":1,"totalLines":121}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8de8beab-a06e-439c-b9cd-b244d43a5115","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n            home_path=\"index.html\",\n        )\n    )\n    return out\n","numLines":48,"startLine":1,"totalLines":48}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"737d6a23-1ec4-4ef9-9165-f6f82efc1bec","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"5789d284-cc79-4bf4-8579-c44342e8756f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"cf34409e-6e94-4084-b356-9c198d1f1657","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UzRn3w7WGxuYQ7F4f8eS8D","type":"tool_result","content":"# Future work\n\nFeatures worth building later, deliberately not in this build, and why —\nseparate from `docs/adr/`, because neither of these is a hard architectural\ntrade-off this project is locking in; they're just not worth their cost here.\n\n## Trash with restore and a 30-day auto-delete\n\nField note 8: WordPress sends a deleted Post/Page to a trash instead of\nremoving it, then purges it automatically after a configurable delay. Doing\nthe auto-purge half properly needs something running in the background to\ncheck ages and clear old entries on a schedule — and the admin console here\nonly runs when someone has it open (`uv run cms serve`), with nothing\nscheduled in between. A trash *without* the auto-purge is just a delayed,\nconfusing delete, so it's not worth building half the feature.\n\nFor now: plain delete, with an \"are you sure?\" confirmation before it runs\n(decided alongside this), so CGE doesn't lose a Post by accident — but once\ndeleted, it's gone.\n\n## Scheduled / visibility-gated publish\n\nField note 3: WordPress's publish dialog lets you set a future publish date\nand public/private visibility. The draft → pending → published status\nalready gives CGE a manual visibility gate (see `CONTEXT.md`). A *scheduled*\nfuture-dated auto-publish needs something to flip the status at the right\ntime with nobody watching — which this project doesn't have (`cms publish`\nis a manual, one-way step, ADR-001). A date field that doesn't actually\nschedule anything would look like it works and doesn't, which is worse than\nnot having it.\n\nFor now: if CGE wants a Post live on a specific day, they publish it that\nday.\n---\n# Client brief: Kenyon Center for Global Engagement\n\nThis site should be run by the Kenyon Center for Global Engagement. They are fairly comfortable with computers but it should be relatively easy and intuitive to navigate.\n\nThe people reading the site are Kenyon students (or students from other universities) looking for information on different study abroad programs. They want to read blog posts on the experience, as well as specific posts tailored towards questions about housing, meal plans, social life, academics, and other hot topics.\n\nAs of right now, Kenyon does not have a site like this and information about study abroad programs has to come from outside sources and sites, not always well maintained and often difficult to navigate for specific information. This is a great system because it allows students to easily get real information about study abroad programs they are interested in, tailored to their specific questions and directly from other students who have attended said programs at Kenyon.\n\nCGE staff will take the administrative roles, adding students with permissions to write blog posts but not edit the site further than that. CGE staff have full administrative privileges, allowing them to add, remove, and change other users, as well as write posts and create pages themselves. Ideally, they would reach out to students going abroad to be ambassadors (possibly a paid position) in which they write a certain amount of blog posts throughout their time abroad.\n\nThe site would have a home page to orient students, and then would be organized into continent pages, each which would have the countries in which Kenyon provides programs, and within those individual country pages would be program pages with blog posts. Those program pages would have general blog posts, as well as a couple of sections relating to the aforementioned hot topics. These posts would be sorted by date. I would also like to add a search function, which would work for countries, programs, and posts and have standard filters (date, relevance).\n\nWhat must not happen: a student ambassador must never be able to publish a post without CGE review, or edit or delete anyone else's posts, and nothing unapproved should ever appear on the public site.\n\n## What I'd add next\n\n- Private messaging so students can ask ambassadors follow-up questions without contact info going public. This needs a live server.\n- A visitor account role so readers can comment on posts and send messages.\n- An IT/developer role that can edit the site's layout and code, separate from CGE admins.\n- Search filters by views and comments, which need a live server to track them.","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"368f6a85-01f8-4faa-b9c6-f1856ad25a56","timestamp":"2026-10-05T06:19:54.022Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"# Future work\n\nFeatures worth building later, deliberately not in this build, and why —\nseparate from `docs/adr/`, because neither of these is a hard architectural\ntrade-off this project is locking in; they're just not worth their cost here.\n\n## Trash with restore and a 30-day auto-delete\n\nField note 8: WordPress sends a deleted Post/Page to a trash instead of\nremoving it, then purges it automatically after a configurable delay. home)} for c in children\n        ],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{path:path}\")\ndef public_page(request: Request, path: str):\n    page = resolve_page(path)\n    if page is None or page.status != It and\nthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\napp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n\nOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef resolve_page(path: str) -> models.Page | None:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n    current = home\n    for segment in segments:\n        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n        if child is None:\n            return None\n        current = child\n    return current\n\n\ndef _path_for(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"/\"\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(page) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(page.slug)\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n\n\ndef page_context(page: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != page.id]\n    children = models.list_published_children(page.id)\n    return {\n        \"page\": page,\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(page.body),\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\"}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home)} for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors]\n        + [{\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _path_for(page, home)}],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n        \"children\": [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home)} for c in children\n        ],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{path:path}\")\ndef public_page(request: Request, path: str):\n    page = resolve_page(path)\n    if page is None or page.status != \"published\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"public/page.html\", {\"title\": page.title, **page_context(page)}\n    )\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":13,"oldLines":6,"newStart":13,"newLines":7,"lines":[" from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates"," "," from app import models, settings","+from app.publish Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\n.site-nav, .site-footer-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1rem;\n}\n.breadcrumb { font-size: 0.9rem; margin-block: 0.5rem; }\n\n@media (max-width: 480px) {\n  .site-nav, .site-footer-nav { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; }\n}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n -> list[str]:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return []\n    return [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id] + [page.slug]\n\n\ndef _relative_link(from_chain: list[str], to_chain: list[str]) -> str:\n    up = \"../\" * len(from_chain)\n    if not to_chain:\n        return f\"{up}index.html\" if up else \"index.html\"\n    return f\"{up}{'/'.join(to_chain)}/index.html\"\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    all_pages = models.list_all_pages()\n    chains = {p.id: ]\n\n        html = template.render(\n            title=page.title,\n            page=page,\n            body_html=markdown.render(page.body),\n            css_path=css_path,\n            nav=nav,\n Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\n.site-nav, .site-footer-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1rem;\n}\n.breadcrumb { font-size: 0.9rem; margin-block: 0.5rem; }\n\n@media (max-width: 480px) {\n  .site-nav, .site-footer-nav { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; }\n}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _slug_chain(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> list[str]:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return []\n    return [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id] + [page.slug]\n\n\ndef _relative_link(from_chain: list[str], to_chain: list[str]) -> str:\n    up = \"../\" * len(from_chain)\n    if not to_chain:\n        return f\"{up}index.html\" if up else \"index.html\"\n    return f\"{up}{'/'.join(to_chain)}/index.html\"\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    all_pages = models.list_all_pages()\n    chains = {p.id: _slug_chain(p, home) for p in all_pages}\n\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n\n    template = env.get_template(\"public/page.html\")\n\n    for page in all_pages:\n        if page.status != \"published\":\n            continue\n        chain = chains[page.id]\n        css_path = _relative_link(chain, [])[: -len(\"index.html\")] + \"style.css\"\n        nav = [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, [])}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n            for c in continents\n        ]\n        ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id]\n        breadcrumb = [\n            {\"title\": home.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, [])}\n        ] + [\n            {\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[a.id])}\n            for a in ancestors\n        ] + [{\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chain)}]\n        footer_links = [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[f.id])}\n            for f in footer_pages\n        ]\n        children = [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n            for c in models.list_published_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n        html = template.render(\n            title=page.title,\n            page=page,\n            body_html=markdown.render(page.body),\n            css_path=css_path,\n            nav=nav,\n            breadcrumb=breadcrumb,\n            footer_links=footer_links,\n            children=children,\n        )\n\n        page_dir = out.joinpath(*chain) if chain else out\n        page_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        (page_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(html)\n\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":83,"oldLines":12,"newStart":83,"newLines":9,"lines":["             {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}","             for c in \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n        \"children\": [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home)} for c in children\n        ],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{path:path}\")\ndef public_page(request: Request, path: str):\n    page = resolve_page(path)\n    if page is None or page.status != {"parentUuid":"ac72d2aa-02fd-44b5-80af-083ebaf71252","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"cf34409e-6e94-4084-b356-9c198d1f1657","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DT8aK3xNu6x2hAmhgfkbmU","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t#!/usr/bin/env python3\n2\t\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n3\t\n4\t    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n5\t\n6\tT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n7\t  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n8\t  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n9\t\n10\tThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n11\t(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n12\t\"\"\"\n13\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n14\t\n15\timport os\n16\timport sys\n17\t\n18\tsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n19\t\n20\tfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n21\t\n22\t\n23\tdef main() -> int:\n24\t    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n25\t    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n26\t    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n27\t    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n28\t        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n29\t              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n30\t        return 1\n31\t\n32\t    db.init_db()\n33\t    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n34\t        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n35\t        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n36\t        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n37\t    ]:\n38\t        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n39\t            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n40\t                                display_name=name, active=active)\n41\t    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n42\t    return 0\n43\t\n44\t\n45\tif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n46\t    sys.exit(main())\n47\t"}]},"uuid":"ecc079c7-11a6-4400-bd34-2588485b59fd","timestamp":"2026-10-05T06:23:18.248Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/seed_demo.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","numLines":47,"startLine":1,"totalLines":47}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ac72d2aa-02fd-44b5-80af-083ebaf71252","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, programs in
