Pages — the content tree, authoring, and early cms publish.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import slugs\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n\ndef _create_page(c, parent_id, title, show_in_footer=False):\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/pages/new?parent_id={parent_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    data = {\"parent_id\": str(parent_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": f\"Body for {title}\",\n            \"csrf_token\": token}\n    if show_in_footer:\n        data[\"show_in_footer\"] = \"on\"\n    return c.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_a_nested_page(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    response = _create_page(c, home.id, \"Asia\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n\n    asia = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"asia\")\n    assert asia is not None\n    assert asia.status == \"draft\"\n    assert asia.title == \"Asia\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_a_standalone_footer_page(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"About CGE\", show_in_footer=True)\n\n    about = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"about-cge\")\n    assert about.show_in_footer is True\n\n\ndef test_delete_requires_confirmation_then_deletes(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Scratch Page\")\n    page = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"scratch-page\")\n\n    confirm = c.get(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/delete\")\n    assert confirm.status_code == 200\n    assert \"are you sure\" in confirm.text.lower()\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(confirm.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/delete\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_page_by_id(page.id) is None\n\n\ndef test_slug_regenerates_while_draft_then_freezes_on_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"First Title\")\n    page = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"first-title\")\n    assert page.slug == \"first-title\"\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Renamed Title\", \"body\": \"x\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n           follow_redirects=False)\n    renamed = models.get_page_by_id(page.id)\n    assert renamed.slug == \"renamed-title\"\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin/pages\").text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token},\n           follow_redirects=False)\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Title After Publish\", \"body\": \"x\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n           follow_redirects=False)\n    after_publish = models.get_page_by_id(page.id)\n    assert after_publish.title == \"Title After Publish\"\n    assert after_publish.slug == \"renamed-title\"  # frozen\n\n\ndef test_editor_blocked_from_page_authoring_routes(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    assert c.get(\"/admin/pages\").status_code == 403\n    assert c.get(f\"/admin/pages/new?parent_id={home.id}\").status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_anonymous_redirected_to_login_for_page_authoring_routes(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin/pages\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_only_published_pages_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Asia\")\n    asia = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"asia\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin/pages\").text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{asia.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Still Draft\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"still-draft\").exists()\n\n    asia_html = (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in asia_html and 'src=\"/' not in asia_html\n    assert \"../style.css\" in asia_html\n    assert \"../index.html\" in asia_html  # nav link back to Home\n\n\ndef test_footer_flagged_page_appears_sitewide_in_footer(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Contact Us\", show_in_footer=True)\n    contact = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"contact-us\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin/pages\").text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{contact.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    home_html = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Contact Us\" in home_html\n    # Footer-flagged pages are excluded from Home's own child listing.\n    assert 'href=\"contact-us/' not in home_html.split(\"<footer\")[0]\n\n\ndef test_live_preview_matches_publish_visibility(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Live Draft\")\n    draft = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"live-draft\")\n\n    assert c.get(\"/live-draft/\").status_code == 404\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin/pages\").text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{draft.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert c.get(\"/live-draft/\").status_code == 200\n\n\n# -- Services seam: pure functions, no HTTP or DB --------------------------\n\ndef test_slugify_collapses_non_alnum_runs():\n    assert slugs.slugify(\"Kyoto Exchange!!\") == \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    assert slugs.slugify(\"  Leading/Trailing  \") == \"leading-trailing\"\n\n\ndef test_slugify_empty_title_falls_back():\n    assert slugs.slugify(\"???\") == \"page\"\n\n\ndef test_dedupe_appends_numeric_suffix():\n    assert slugs.dedupe(\"asia\", I have sufficient verified findings now.\n\n```json\n[\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/models.py\",\n    \"line\": 213,\n    \"summary\": \"create_page() inserts a page with an unvalidated parent_id, so a stale or tampered parent_id raises an unhandled sqlite3.IntegrityError instead of a clean error.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Admin A deletes a page while Admin B still has its stale 'add child' link open (rendered from app/routes/pages.py's tree); B submits POST /admin/pages/new with that parent_id. models.create_page() computes sibling_slugs against the now-empty parent_id (no existence check) and executes INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, ...) with pragma foreign_keys=ON (app/db.py:39), which raises sqlite3.IntegrityError: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed, crashing the request with a 500 and a raw traceback instead of a 404/400. Verified directly: an INSERT with a non-existent parent_id against this exact schema raises IntegrityError.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/pages.py\",\n    \"line\": 85,\n    \"summary\": \"edit_page_form (GET /admin/pages/{page_id}/edit) dereferences page.parent_id without checking that get_page_by_id() returned a page, crashing on any stale/invalid page_id.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"GET /admin/pages/99999/edit (page deleted or id guessed) → models.get_page_by_id returns None → page.parent_id raises AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'parent_id', a 500 instead of a 404. The identical pattern recurs in update_page's error path (app/routes/pages.py:100, page.parent_id) and inside models.update_page (app/models.py:235, page.status) when the title is non-empty. Verified directly: calling models.update_page(99999, ...) raises AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'status'.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/pages.py\",\n    \"line\": 127,\n    \"summary\": \"delete_page / confirm_delete_page never guard against deleting the single root Home page, and the pages table's ON DELETE CASCADE (app/db.py:22) means deleting it wipes the entire page tree.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"An admin visits GET /admin/pages/{home.id}/delete (home.id is a small, guessable/known id, and ensure_home_page() always returns it) and confirms. models.delete_page(home.id) issues DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?, and because every other page is a (grand)descendant through parent_id ON DELETE CASCADE, the entire authored site is destroyed in one request. The admin UI doesn't link to this URL for Home, but nothing in the route or model stops a direct hit, and ensure_home_page() will silently fabricate a fresh empty Home afterward, masking that all prior content is gone.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/models.py\",\n    \"line\": 102,\n    \"summary\": \"ensure_home_page() is a check-then-insert with no unique constraint on parent_id IS NULL, so concurrent first-requests can create two root Home pages.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Two near-simultaneous requests (FastAPI runs sync def routes in a thread pool) both call ensure_home_page() before either has committed; both see get_home_page() return None and both INSERT a parent_id=NULL 'Home' row. Afterward get_home_page()'s `SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id IS NULL` with fetchone() picks one of the two nondeterministically on each call, so which 'Home' (and which page tree) the admin console or public site resolves to can flip between requests. Confirming this needs concurrent requests hitting a fresh DB, so this is PLAUSIBLE rather than certain in normal single-request test runs.\"\n  }\n]\n```</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>76170</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>24</tool_uses><duration_ms>215367</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

  finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_children(parent_id: int) -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE AND slug = ?\", (parent_id, slug)\n        ).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_all_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages\").fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_ancestors(page: Page) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Home first, down to (but not including) `page` itself.\"\"\"\n    chain: list[Page] = []\n    current = page\n    while current.parent_id is not None:\n        parent = get_page_by_id(current.parent_id)\n        chain.append(parent)\n        current = parent\n    chain.reverse()\n    return chain\n\n\ndef create_page(\n    parent_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool, author_id: int\n) -> Page:\n    sibling_slugs = {c.slug for c in list_children(parent_id)}\n    slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?)\",\n            (parent_id, title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_page(page_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool) -> Page:\n    page = get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if page.status == \"draft\":\n        sibling_slugs = {\n            c.slug for c in list_children(page.parent_id) if c.id != page.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n        slug = page.slug  # User and Page reads and writes.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.services import passwords, slugs\n\n\nROLE_LABELS = {\"admin\": \"Staff\", \"editor\": \"Ambassador\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    password_hash: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str\n    active: bool\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def role_label(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The UI-facing role name (CONTEXT.md: Staff/Ambassador, never admin/editor).\"\"\"\n        return ROLE_LABELS[self.role]\n\n\ndef _row_to_user(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        email=row[\"email\"],\n        password_hash=row[\"password_hash\"],\n        role=row[\"role\"],\n        display_name=row[\"display_name\"],\n        active=bool(row[\"active\"]),\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef create_user(\n    email: str, password: str, role: str, display_name: str, active: bool = True\n) -> User:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name, active) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, passwords.hash_password(password), role, display_name, int(active)),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_user_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_id(user_id: int) -> User | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_user(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_email(email: str) -> User | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_user(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    id: int\n    parent_id: int | None\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: str\n    show_in_footer: bool\n    author_id: int | None\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n\ndef _row_to_page(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    return Page(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        parent_id=row[\"parent_id\"],\n        title=row[\"title\"],\n        slug=row[\"slug\"],\n        body=row[\"body\"],\n        status=row[\"status\"],\n        show_in_footer=bool(row[\"show_in_footer\"]),\n        author_id=row[\"author_id\"],\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n        published_at=row[\"published_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef get_page_by_id(page_id: int) -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_home_page() -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id IS NULL\").fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef ensure_home_page() -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Create the single root Page (no parent) if it doesn't exist yet.\n\n    Guarded by a partial unique index (db.py: idx_pages_single_home) against\n    two concurrent first-requests both inserting a Home row; the loser's\n    insert raises IntegrityError here, and we just re-read the winner's row.\n    \"\"\"\n    home = get_home_page()\n    if home is not None:\n        return home\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id, published_at) \"\n            \"VALUES (NULL, 'Home', '', '', 'published', 0, NULL, \"\n            \"strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))\"\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return get_home_page()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_children(parent_id: int) -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? ORDER BY title\", (parent_id,)\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_published_children(parent_id: int) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Non-footer, published children — the generic \"body lists its children\" rule.\"\"\"\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? AND status = 'published' \"\n            \"AND show_in_footer = 0 ORDER BY title\",\n            (parent_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_footer_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE status = 'published' AND show_in_footer = 1 \"\n            \"ORDER BY title\"\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_child_by_slug(parent_id: int, slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? AND slug = ?\", (parent_id, slug)\n        ).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_all_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages\").fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_ancestors(page: Page) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Home first, down to (but not including) `page` itself.\"\"\"\n    chain: list[Page] = []\n    current = page\n    while current.parent_id is not None:\n        parent = get_page_by_id(current.parent_id)\n        chain.append(parent)\n        current = parent\n    chain.reverse()\n    return chain\n\n\ndef create_page(\n    parent_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool, author_id: int\n) -> Page:\n    sibling_slugs = {c.slug for c in list_children(parent_id)}\n    slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?)\",\n            (parent_id, title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_page(page_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool) -> Page:\n    page = get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if page.status == \"draft\":\n        sibling_slugs = {\n            c.slug for c in list_children(page.parent_id) if c.id != page.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n        slug = page.slug  # frozen the moment status leaves draft\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE pages SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, show_in_footer = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), page_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef publish_page(page_id: int) -> Page:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE pages SET status = 'published', \"\n            \"published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (page_id,),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":222,"oldLines":6,"newStart":222,"newLines":8,"lines":[" def create_page(","     parent_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool, author_id: int"," ) -> Page:","+    if get_page_by_id(parent_id) is None:","+        raise ValueError(f\"parent page {parent_id} does not exist\")","     sibling_slugs = {c.slug for c in list_children(parent_id)}","     slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)","     conn = db.get_connection()"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d4867180-1176-4f40-8d54-2bcba7297d81","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

slugs\n\n\nROLE_LABELS = {\"admin\": \"Staff\", \"editor\": \"Ambassador\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    password_hash: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str\n    active: bool\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def role_label(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The UI-facing role name (CONTEXT.md: Staff/Ambassador, never admin/editor).\"\"\"\n        return ROLE_LABELS[self.role]\n\n\ndef _row_to_user(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        email=row[\"email\"],\n        password_hash=row[\"password_hash\"],\n        role=row[\"role\"],\n        display_name=row[\"display_name\"],\n        active=bool(row[\"active\"]),\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef create_user(\n    email: str, password: str, role: str, display_name: str, active: bool = True\n) -> User:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name, active) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, passwords.hash_password(password), role, display_name, int(active)),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_user_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_id(user_id: int) -> User | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_user(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_email(email: str) -> User | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_user(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    id: int\n    parent_id: int | None\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: str\n    show_in_footer: bool\n    author_id: int | None\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n\ndef _row_to_page(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    return Page(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        parent_id=row[\"parent_id\"],\n        title=row[\"title\"],\n        slug=row[\"slug\"],\n        body=row[\"body\"],\n        status=row[\"status\"],\n        show_in_footer=bool(row[\"show_in_footer\"]),\n        author_id=row[\"author_id\"],\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n        published_at=row[\"published_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef get_page_by_id(page_id: int) -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_home_page() -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id IS NULL\").fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef ensure_home_page() -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Create the single root Page (no parent) if it doesn't exist yet.\n\n    Guarded by a partial unique index (db.py: idx_pages_single_home) against\n    two concurrent first-requests both inserting a Home row; the loser's\n    insert raises IntegrityError here, and we just re-read the winner's row.\n    \"\"\"\n    home = get_home_page()\n    if home is not None:\n        return home\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id, published_at) \"\n            \"VALUES (NULL, 'Home', '', '', 'published', 0, NULL, \"\n            \"strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))\"\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return get_home_page()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_children(parent_id: int) -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? ORDER BY title\", (parent_id,)\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_published_children(parent_id: int) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Non-footer, published children — the generic \"body lists its children\" rule.\"\"\"\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? AND status = 'published' \"\n            \"AND show_in_footer = 0 ORDER BY title\",\n            (parent_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_footer_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE status = 'published' AND show_in_footer = 1 \"\n            \"ORDER BY title\"\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_child_by_slug(parent_id: int, slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? AND slug = ?\", (parent_id, slug)\n        ).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_all_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages\").fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_ancestors(page: Page) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Home first, down to (but not including) `page` itself.\"\"\"\n    chain: list[Page] = []\n    current = page\n    while current.parent_id is not None:\n        parent = get_page_by_id(current.parent_id)\n        chain.append(parent)\n        current = parent\n    chain.reverse()\n    return chain\n\n\ndef create_page(\n    parent_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool, author_id: int\n) -> Page:\n    if get_page_by_id(parent_id) is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"parent page {parent_id} does not exist\")\n    sibling_slugs = {c.slug for c in list_children(parent_id)}\n    slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?)\",\n            (parent_id, title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_page(page_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool) -> Page:\n    page = get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if page.status == \"draft\":\n        sibling_slugs = {\n            c.slug for c in list_children(page.parent_id) if c.id != page.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n        slug = page.slug  # frozen the moment status leaves draft\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE pages SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, show_in_footer = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), page_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef publish_page(page_id: int) -> Page:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE pages SET status = 'published', \"\n            \"published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (page_id,),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":241,"oldLines":6,"newStart":241,"newLines":8,"lines":[" "," def update_page(page_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool) -> Page:","     page = get_page_by_id(page_id)","+    if page is None:","+        raise ValueError(f\"page {page_id} does not exist\")","     if page.status == \"draft\":","         sibling_slugs = {","             c.slug for c in list_children(page.parent_id) if c.id != page.id"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e0606db8-6b84-4d46-9da7-ad121a26b217","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

slugs\n\n\nROLE_LABELS = {\"admin\": \"Staff\", \"editor\": \"Ambassador\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    password_hash: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str\n    active: bool\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def role_label(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The UI-facing role name (CONTEXT.md: Staff/Ambassador, never admin/editor).\"\"\"\n        return ROLE_LABELS[self.role]\n\n\ndef _row_to_user(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        email=row[\"email\"],\n        password_hash=row[\"password_hash\"],\n        role=row[\"role\"],\n        display_name=row[\"display_name\"],\n        active=bool(row[\"active\"]),\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef create_user(\n    email: str, password: str, role: str, display_name: str, active: bool = True\n) -> User:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name, active) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, passwords.hash_password(password), role, display_name, int(active)),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_user_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_id(user_id: int) -> User | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_user(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_email(email: str) -> User | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_user(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    id: int\n    parent_id: int | None\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: str\n    show_in_footer: bool\n    author_id: int | None\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n\ndef _row_to_page(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    return Page(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        parent_id=row[\"parent_id\"],\n        title=row[\"title\"],\n        slug=row[\"slug\"],\n        body=row[\"body\"],\n        status=row[\"status\"],\n        show_in_footer=bool(row[\"show_in_footer\"]),\n        author_id=row[\"author_id\"],\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n        published_at=row[\"published_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef get_page_by_id(page_id: int) -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_home_page() -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id IS NULL\").fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef ensure_home_page() -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Create the single root Page (no parent) if it doesn't exist yet.\n\n    Guarded by a partial unique index (db.py: idx_pages_single_home) against\n    two concurrent first-requests both inserting a Home row; the loser's\n    insert raises IntegrityError here, and we just re-read the winner's row.\n    \"\"\"\n    home = get_home_page()\n    if home is not None:\n        return home\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id, published_at) \"\n            \"VALUES (NULL, 'Home', '', '', 'published', 0, NULL, \"\n            \"strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))\"\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return get_home_page()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_children(parent_id: int) -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? ORDER BY title\", (parent_id,)\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_published_children(parent_id: int) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Non-footer, published children — the generic \"body lists its children\" rule.\"\"\"\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? AND status = 'published' \"\n            \"AND show_in_footer = 0 ORDER BY title\",\n            (parent_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_footer_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE status = 'published' AND show_in_footer = 1 \"\n            \"ORDER BY title\"\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_child_by_slug(parent_id: int, slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? AND slug = ?\", (parent_id, slug)\n        ).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_all_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages\").fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_ancestors(page: Page) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Home first, down to (but not including) `page` itself.\"\"\"\n    chain: list[Page] = []\n    current = page\n    while current.parent_id is not None:\n        parent = get_page_by_id(current.parent_id)\n        chain.append(parent)\n        current = parent\n    chain.reverse()\n    return chain\n\n\ndef create_page(\n    parent_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool, author_id: int\n) -> Page:\n    if get_page_by_id(parent_id) is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"parent page {parent_id} does not exist\")\n    sibling_slugs = {c.slug for c in list_children(parent_id)}\n    slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?)\",\n            (parent_id, title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_page(page_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool) -> Page:\n    page = get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if page is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"page {page_id} does not exist\")\n    if page.status == \"draft\":\n        sibling_slugs = {\n            c.slug for c in list_children(page.parent_id) if c.id != page.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n        slug = page.slug  # frozen the moment status leaves draft\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE pages SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, show_in_footer = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), page_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef publish_page(page_id: int) -> Page:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE pages SET status = 'published', \"\n            \"published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (page_id,),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":279,"oldLines":6,"newStart":279,"newLines":9,"lines":[" "," "," def delete_page(page_id: int) -> None:","+    page = get_page_by_id(page_id)","+    if page is not None and page.parent_id is None:","+        raise ValueError(\"cannot delete the Home page\")","     conn = db.get_connection()","     try:","         conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fe3ff8db-d723-4072-a202-962c3cc4d282","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

return [\n            {\"page\": child, \"children\": tree(child)}\n            for child in models.list_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_admin, verify_csrf\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/pages\")\n\n\ndef _render_form(request, page: models.Page | None, parent_id: int, error: str | None = None):\n    parent = models.get_page_by_id(parent_id)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit page\" if page else \"New page\",\n            \"page\": page,\n            \"parent\": parent,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_pages(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n\n    def tree(page: models.Page) -> list[dict]:\n        return [\n            {\"page\": child, \"children\": tree(child)}\n            for child in models.list_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Pages\", \"home\": home, \"tree\": tree(home), \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_page_form(\n    request: Request, parent_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_page(\n    request: Request,\n    parent_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\")\n    models.create_page(\n        parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=body,\n        show_in_footer=bool(show_in_footer), author_id=user.id,\n    )\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_page_form(\n    request: Request, page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    page = models.get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    return _render_form(request, page=page, parent_id=page.parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_page(\n    request: Request,\n    page_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    page = models.get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, page=page, parent_id=page.parent_id,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\")\n    models.update_page(page_id, title=title, body=body, show_in_footer=bool(show_in_footer))\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/publish\")\nasync def publish_page(\n    page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    models.publish_page(page_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_page(\n    request: Request, page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    page = models.get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Delete page?\", \"page\": page, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_page(\n    page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    models.delete_page(page_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_admin, verify_csrf\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/pages\")\n\n\ndef _get_page_or_404(page_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    page = models.get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such page\")\n    return page\n\n\ndef _render_form(request, page: models.Page | None, parent_id: int, error: str | None = None):\n    parent = _get_page_or_404(parent_id)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit page\" if page else \"New page\",\n            \"page\": page,\n            \"parent\": parent,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_pages(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n\n    def tree(page: models.Page) -> list[dict]:\n        return [\n            {\"page\": child, \"children\": tree(child)}\n            for child in models.list_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Pages\", \"home\": home, \"tree\": tree(home), \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_page_form(\n    request: Request, parent_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_page(\n    request: Request,\n    parent_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\")\n    models.create_page(\n        parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=body,\n        show_in_footer=bool(show_in_footer), author_id=user.id,\n    )\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_page_form(\n show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    page = models.get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if not import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_admin, verify_csrf\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/pages\")\n\n\ndef _get_page_or_404(page_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    page = models.get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such page\")\n    return page\n\n\ndef _render_form(request, page: models.Page | None, parent_id: int, error: str | None = None):\n    parent = _get_page_or_404(parent_id)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit page\" if page else \"New page\",\n            \"page\": page,\n            \"parent\": parent,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_pages(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n\n    def tree(page: models.Page) -> list[dict]:\n        return [\n            {\"page\": child, \"children\": tree(child)}\n            for child in models.list_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Pages\", \"home\": home, \"tree\": tree(home), \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_page_form(\n    request: Request, parent_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_page(\n    request: Request,\n    parent_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_page_or_404(parent_id)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\")\n    models.create_page(\n        parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=body,\n        show_in_footer=bool(show_in_footer), author_id=user.id,\n    )\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_page_form(\n    request: Request, page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    page = _get_page_or_404(page_id)\n    return _render_form(request, page=page, parent_id=page.parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_page(\n    request: Request,\n    page_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None =  if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such page\")\n    return page\n\n\ndef _render_form(request, page: models.Page | None, parent_id: int, error: str | None = \"title\": \"Edit page\" if page else \"New page\",\n            \"page\": page,\n            \"parent\": parent,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_pages(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n\n    def tree(page: models.Page) -> list[dict]:\n        return [\n            {\"page\": child, \"children\": tree(child)}\n            for child in models.list_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Pages\", \"home\": home, \"tree\": tree(home), \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_page_form(\n    request: Request, parent_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_page(\n    request: Request,\n    parent_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_page_or_404(parent_id)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\")\n    models.create_page(\n        parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=body,\n        show_in_footer=bool(show_in_footer), author_id=user.id,\n    )\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\ndef parent_id=page.parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_page(\n    request: Request,\n    page_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    page = _get_page_or_404(page_id)\n    if not annotations\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import slugs\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n\ndef _create_page(c, parent_id, title, show_in_footer=False):\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/pages/new?parent_id={parent_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    data = {\"parent_id\": str(parent_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": f\"Body for {title}\",\n            \"csrf_token\": token}\n    if show_in_footer:\n        data[\"show_in_footer\"] = \"on\"\n    return c.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_a_nested_page(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    response = _create_page(c, home.id, \"Asia\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n\n    asia = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"asia\")\n    assert asia is not None\n    assert asia.status == \"draft\"\n    assert asia.title == \"Asia\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_a_standalone_footer_page(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"About CGE\", show_in_footer=True)\n\n    about = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"about-cge\")\n    assert about.show_in_footer is True\n\n\ndef test_delete_requires_confirmation_then_deletes(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Scratch Page\")\n    page = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"scratch-page\")\n\n    confirm = c.get(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/delete\")\n    assert confirm.status_code == 200\n    assert \"are you sure\" in confirm.text.lower()\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(confirm.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/delete\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_page_by_id(page.id) is None\n\n\ndef test_slug_regenerates_while_draft_then_freezes_on_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"First Title\")\n    page = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"first-title\")\n    assert page.slug == \"first-title\"\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Renamed Title\", \"body\": \"x\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n           follow_redirects=False)\n    renamed = models.get_page_by_id(page.id)\n    assert renamed.slug == \"renamed-title\"\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin/pages\").text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token},\n           follow_redirects=False)\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Title After Publish\", \"body\": \"x\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n           follow_redirects=False)\n    after_publish = models.get_page_by_id(page.id)\n    assert after_publish.title == \"Title After Publish\"\n    assert after_publish.slug == \"renamed-title\"  # frozen\n\n\ndef test_editor_blocked_from_page_authoring_routes(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    assert c.get(\"/admin/pages\").status_code == 403\n    assert c.get(f\"/admin/pages/new?parent_id={home.id}\").status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_anonymous_redirected_to_login_for_page_authoring_routes(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin/pages\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_only_published_pages_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Asia\")\n    asia = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"asia\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin/pages\").text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{asia.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Still Draft\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"still-draft\").exists()\n\n    asia_html = (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in asia_html and 'src=\"/' not in asia_html\n    assert \"../style.css\" in asia_html\n    assert \"../index.html\" in asia_html  # nav link back to Home\n\n\ndef test_footer_flagged_page_appears_sitewide_in_footer(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    _create_page(c, home.id, \"Contact Us\", show_in_footer=True)\n    contact = models.get_child_by_slug(home.id, \"contact-us\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin/pages\").text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{contact.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    home_html = (out /   c.post(f\"/admin/pages/{draft.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert c.get(\"/live-draft/\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef {"parentUuid":"05fbaad0-90cb-4ebc-a293-17ca9802c58a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CficyoSv2FVmRHQfM3q3J","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QVLKVTUXg9Yvg5uFqB8vqM","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"gh issue comment 3 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings (medium effort) and resolutions\n\n1. **`create_page()` crashed with a raw `sqlite3.IntegrityError` (500) on a stale/invalid `parent_id`** instead of a clean error — e.g. one admin deletes a page while another still has its \"add child\" link open.\n   - **Resolved**: `models.create_page()` now checks the parent exists and raises `ValueError`; `app/routes/pages.py` checks first and returns 404.\n\n2. **Several page routes (`edit`, `update`, `confirm_delete`) dereferenced `get_page_by_id()`'s result without a None check**, crashing with `AttributeError` on any stale/guessed `page_id`.\n   - **Resolved**: added a `_get_page_or_404()` helper in `app/routes/pages.py`, used by every route that loads a page by id; Verified directly against the real schema.\n\nAdded 3 regression tests covering findings 1–3 (`tests/test_t02.py`). {"parentUuid":"9efffbeb-ec48-4045-81fb-7e7cbf86a143","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"b55721ec-7254-42c8-9d8f-015135c5dd1d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"<bash-stdout>title:\tT02: Pages — the content tree, authoring, and early cms publish\nstate:\tCLOSED\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tticket\ncomments:\t2\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#2\nblocking:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#8, adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#4\nnumber:\t3\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff builds the Continent → Country → Program tree (or a standalone Page under Home) from the admin console; a published Page is live both in the admin console's preview and through `cms publish`, with the Home+Continents nav bar, a breadcrumb trail, and the footer for flagged pages — so the public site is genuinely deployable this early, before Posts exist.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] Staff creates, edits, and deletes a Page nested under any existing Page, or standalone under Home with \"show in footer\" checked.\n- [ ] Deleting a Page asks \"are you sure?\" before it runs.\n- [ ] A Page's slug auto-generates from its title, regenerates while draft, and freezes the moment it's published.\n- [ ] An Ambassador is blocked from every Page-authoring route (403), and an anonymous request is redirected to login.\n- [ ] `cms publish` writes every published Page to `site/`: the nav bar (Home + Continents), a breadcrumb trail built from the parent chain, the footer for flagged pages, and each Page's body listing its non-footer children (Home's body lists only the Continents) — every link relative.\n- [ ] A draft Page never appears in `cms publish`'s output.\n- [ ] The nav bar wraps or collapses at phone width.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds Asia, Africa, and Europe as Continents, a couple of Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, plus an About CGE and a Contact Us standalone page (footer-flagged) — all with generated placeholder copy, published.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: #2 (T01: Login, sessions, and role-gated access)</bash-stdout><bash-stderr></bash-stderr>"},"uuid":"1a2fccfa-545f-456a-b2e5-666040c2fedc","timestamp":"2026-10-05T06:37:26.872Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#4\nnumber:\t3\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff builds the Continent → Country → Program tree (or a standalone Page under Home) from the admin console; a published Page is live both in the admin console's preview and through `cms publish`, with the Home+Continents nav bar, a breadcrumb trail, and the footer for flagged pages — so the public site is genuinely deployable this early, before Posts exist.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] Staff creates, edits, and deletes a Page nested under any existing Page, or standalone under Home with \"show in footer\" checked.\n- [ ] Deleting a Page asks \"are you sure?\" before it runs.\n- [ ] A Page's slug auto-generates from its title, regenerates while draft, and freezes the moment it's published.\n- [ ] An Ambassador is blocked from every Page-authoring route (403), and an anonymous request is redirected to login.\n- [ ] `cms publish` writes every published Page to `site/`: the nav bar (Home + Continents), a breadcrumb trail built from the parent chain, the footer for flagged pages, and each Page's body listing its non-footer children (Home's body lists only the Continents) — every link relative.\n- [ ] A draft Page never appears in `cms publish`'s output.\n- [ ] The nav bar wraps or collapses at phone width.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds Asia, Africa, and Europe as Continents, a couple of Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, plus an About CGE and a Contact Us standalone page (footer-flagged) — all with generated placeholder copy, published.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: #2 (T01: Login, sessions, and role-gated `cms publish`'s output (started in T02 for Pages) now includes Posts too.\n8\t\n9\t## Acceptance criteria\n10\t\n11\t- [ ] A published Program page lists its Posts grouped by Topic.\n12\t- [ ] A visitor can filter a Program page to one Topic, or see all Posts.\n13\t- [ ] A Post's Markdown body is sanitized before it is rendered anywhere, public or admin.\n14\t- [ ] A draft or pending Post never appears in a public response or in `cms publish`'s output.\n15\t- [ ] `cms publish` writes every published Post under its Program's path, with every link relative.\n16\t- [ ] A Post's slug stays frozen through a title edit made after it is published.\n17\t- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py`'s published Posts (seeded in T04) render correctly end-to-end through `cms publish`.\n18\t\n19\t## Blocked by\n20\t\n21\tBlocked by: #5 (T04: Posts — the review-gate state machine)\n22\t\n23\t"}]},"uuid":"6354b89f-faf7-494d-8830-b99dabdeb085","timestamp":"2026-10-05T06:49:09.379Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/tmp/issue6_body.md","content":"## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nPublished Posts reach the public site, grouped and filterable by Topic on their Program page; `cms publish`'s output (started in T02 for Pages) now includes Posts too.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A published Program page lists its Posts grouped by Topic.\n- [ ] A visitor can filter a Program page to one Topic, or see all Posts.\n- [ ] A Post's Markdown body is sanitized before it is rendered anywhere, public or admin.\n- [ ] A draft or pending Post never appears in a public response or in `cms publish`'s output.\n- [ ] `cms publish` writes every published Post under its Program's path, with every link relative.\n- [ ] A Post's slug stays frozen through a title edit made after it is published.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py`'s published Posts (seeded in T04) render correctly end-to-end through `cms publish`.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: #5 (T04: Posts — the review-gate state machine)\n\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":15,"oldLines":6,"newStart":15,"newLines":8,"lines":[" - [ ] `cms publish` writes every published Post under its Program's path, with every link relative."," - [ ] A Post's slug stays frozen through a title edit made after it is published."," - [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py`'s published Posts (seeded in T04) render correctly end-to-end through `cms publish`.","+- [ ] The public site gets a clean, readable design using Kenyon purple (nav bar, breadcrumbs, cards for continents/countries/programs, footer).","+- [ ] Every public page works on a phone at 390px wide with no horizontal scrolling."," "," ## Blocked by"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b4c95475-d542-4d9a-9d79-adc0ca6c8c58","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#4\nnumber:\t3\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff builds the Continent → Country → Program tree (or a standalone Page under Home) from the admin console; a published Page is live both in the admin console's preview and through `cms publish`, with the Home+Continents nav bar, a breadcrumb trail, and the footer for flagged pages — so the public site is genuinely deployable this early, before Posts exist.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] Staff creates, edits, and deletes a Page nested under any existing Page, or standalone under Home with \"show in footer\" checked.\n- [ ] Deleting a Page asks \"are you sure?\" before it runs.\n- [ ] A Page's slug auto-generates from its title, regenerates while draft, and freezes the moment it's published.\n- [ ] An Ambassador is blocked from every Page-authoring route (403), and an anonymous request is redirected to login.\n- [ ] `cms publish` writes every published Page to `site/`: the nav bar (Home + Continents), a breadcrumb trail built from the parent chain, the footer for flagged pages, and each Page's body listing its non-footer children (Home's body lists only the Continents) — every link relative.\n- [ ] A draft Page never appears in `cms publish`'s output.\n- [ ] The nav bar wraps or collapses at phone width.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds Asia, Africa, and Europe as Continents, a couple of Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, plus an About CGE and a Contact Us standalone page (footer-flagged) — all with generated placeholder copy, published.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: #2 (T01: Login, sessions, and role-gated Read that\nissue's body directly (`gh issue view 4`) for its acceptance criteria —\nnot duplicated here since it may still change before work starts.\n\nAlso re-read:\n- Spec issue #1 (full data model, Post status state machine table, module\n  split, testing decisions).\n- `CONTEXT.md` (vocabulary — Post/Topic/Status/Hot Topic sections\n  especially).\n- `docs/adr/ADR-004-post-pending-status.md`.\n\n## Non-obvious decisions from this session (not fully spelled out in the code)\n\n- **Module split** (ADR-driven, see spec issue #1): `app/db.py` (schema +\n  connections), `app/models.py` (plain SQLite CRUD, no business logic),\n  `app/services/*.py` (pure functions: `slugs.py`, `passwords.py`,\n  `csrf.py`, `markdown.py` — no FastAPI/SQLite imports), `app/routes/*.py`\n  (thin HTTP handlers). Keep Post work in this same shape.\n- **CSRF**: double-submit via Starlette's `SessionMiddleware`\n  (itsdangerous-signed cookie). `ensure_csrf_token(request)` primes a\n  session token for any GET that renders a form; `verify_csrf` (a\n  dependency) checks it on every POST. Reuse both from\n  `app/routes/auth.py` — don't invent a second mechanism for Post routes.\n- **Role gate**: `require_user` / `require_admin` dependencies in\n  `app/routes/auth.py`, raising `LoginRequired` / `AdminRequired` /\n  `CsrfInvalid`, caught by handlers registered in `app/main.py`. Posts need\n  a *third* gate shape beyond admin-only: \"author owns this Post and it's\n  still draft\" — that's new logic for T03, probably a small check inside\n  the route or a `require_post_owner`-style dependency, not yet written.\n- **Slug freeze rule**: generated from title while `status == \"draft\"`,\n  frozen the instant status leaves draft — implemented for Pages in\n  `models.update_page`; Posts need the identical rule but their state\n  machine has three statuses (draft/pending/published) instead of two, so\n  re-check CONTEXT.md's Status section before assuming the Page code\n  generalizes directly.\n- **Home page singleton**: `pages` table has a partial unique index\n  (`idx_pages_single_home` in `app/db.py`, indexing a constant expression\n  `WHERE parent_id IS NULL`) so only one root Page can ever exist, plus an\n  app-level check-then-insert-then-catch-IntegrityError in\n  `models.ensure_home_page()`. Not directly relevant to Posts, but the\n  partial-unique-index trick is worth knowing if Posts need a similar\n  single-row invariant anywhere.\n- **Live preview == static publish, shared templates**: `app/routes/public.py`\n  (live, absolute URLs, reads DB directly) and `app/publish.py` (static\n  export, relative URLs, writes `site/`) both render `templates/public/page.html`\n  via `templates/public/base.html`, differing only in the href/css values\n  passed into context. When Posts reach the public site (T05, not T03),\n  follow the same pattern rather than writing a third renderer.\n- **Code review workflow**: this session ran `/code-review` (medium\n  effort) via the `code-review` skill as a background fork before each\n  ticket's closing commit, per CLAUDE.md (\"Before a commit that closes a\n  ticket: post the /code-review findings... as a comment on that {"parentUuid":"d81fb187-6ab7-4eb4-ba28-98c355dff301","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"feea377a-a109-45f3-afb4-335b29ab9a24","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01PL3wn9o97NWGKo5Xria1c2","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /tmp/iphs400-mp2-cms-handoff-20261005.md (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"6adb69a7-1691-4af1-8245-573415a41d2a","timestamp":"2026-10-05T06:51:11.083Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/tmp/iphs400-mp2-cms-handoff-20261005.md","content":"# Handoff: iphs400-mp2-cms\n\nRepo: `/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms` (GitHub: `adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms`)\n\n## Where things stand\n\n- **T01** (login/sessions/CSRF/role gate) and **T02** (Pages: content tree,\n  authoring, live preview, `cms publish`) are both implemented, tested,\n  code-reviewed, and merged to `main`. Issues #2 and #3 are `CLOSED`.\n  - T01 commit: `8f829df`. Review comment:\n    https://github.com/adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/2#issuecomment-5989077095\n  - T02 commit: `b6220eb`. Review comment:\n    https://github.com/adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/3#issuecomment-5989342538\n- `main` is pushed through `d0654d5` (ledger chore commit). `gh-pages` branch\n  exists and was deployed (`uv run cms deploy`) with the seeded demo tree.\n- `.claude/state/phase` currently reads `T02` — **update it to `T03` at the\n  start of the next ticket**, per the project's CLAUDE.md workflow.\n- `notes/usage-ledger.csv` has an uncommitted diff right now (fresh usage\n  accrued since the last ledger commit) — harmless, just needs a future\n  `chore: update usage ledger` commit.\n- Issue #6 (T05, \"Public Posts and `cms publish` extended\") had two\n  acceptance criteria added this session (Kenyon-purple design, 390px no\n  horizontal scroll) — not relevant to the next ticket (T03) but worth\n  knowing it's already amended for whoever picks up T05.\n\n## Next ticket\n\n**T03 = issue #4**, \"Posts — draft authoring, Topic, and a Markdown\npreview,\" blocked by #3 (now closed) and itself blocking #8. Read that\nissue's body directly (`gh issue view 4`) for its acceptance criteria —\nnot duplicated here since it may still change before work starts.\n\nAlso re-read:\n- Spec issue #1 (full data model, Post status state machine table, module\n  split, testing decisions).\n- `CONTEXT.md` (vocabulary — Post/Topic/Status/Hot Topic sections\n  especially).\n- `docs/adr/ADR-004-post-pending-status.md`.\n\n## Non-obvious decisions from this session (not fully spelled out in the code)\n\n- **Module split** (ADR-driven, see spec issue #1): `app/db.py` (schema +\n  connections), `app/models.py` (plain SQLite CRUD, no business logic),\n  `app/services/*.py` (pure functions: `slugs.py`, `passwords.py`,\n  `csrf.py`, `markdown.py` — no FastAPI/SQLite imports), `app/routes/*.py`\n  (thin HTTP handlers). Keep Post work in this same shape.\n- **CSRF**: double-submit via Starlette's `SessionMiddleware`\n  (itsdangerous-signed cookie). `ensure_csrf_token(request)` primes a\n  session token for any GET that renders a form; `verify_csrf` (a\n  dependency) checks it on every POST. Reuse both from\n  `app/routes/auth.py` — don't invent a second mechanism for Post routes.\n- **Role gate**: `require_user` / `require_admin` dependencies in\n  `app/routes/auth.py`, raising `LoginRequired` / `AdminRequired` /\n  `CsrfInvalid`, caught by handlers registered in `app/main.py`. Posts need\n  a *third* gate shape beyond admin-only: \"author owns this Post and it's\n  still draft\" — that's new logic for T03, probably a small check inside\n  the route or a `require_post_owner`-style dependency, not yet written.\n- **Slug freeze rule**: generated from title while `status == \"draft\"`,\n  frozen the instant status leaves draft — implemented for Pages in\n  `models.update_page`; Posts need the identical rule but their state\n  machine has three statuses (draft/pending/published) instead of two, so\n  re-check CONTEXT.md's Status section before assuming the Page code\n  generalizes directly.\n- **Home page singleton**: `pages` table has a partial unique index\n  (`idx_pages_single_home` in `app/db.py`, indexing a constant expression\n  `WHERE parent_id IS NULL`) so only one root Page can ever exist, plus an\n  app-level check-then-insert-then-catch-IntegrityError in\n  `models.ensure_home_page()`. Not directly relevant to Posts, but the\n  partial-unique-index trick is worth knowing if Posts need a similar\n  single-row invariant anywhere.\n- **Live preview == static publish, shared templates**: `app/routes/public.py`\n  (live, absolute URLs, reads DB directly) and `app/publish.py` (static\n  export, relative URLs, writes `site/`) both render `templates/public/page.html`\n  via `templates/public/base.html`, differing only in the href/css values\n  passed into context. When Posts reach the public site (T05, not T03),\n  follow the same pattern rather than writing a third renderer.\n- **Code review workflow**: this session ran `/code-review` (medium\n  effort) via the `code-review` skill as a background fork before each\n  ticket's closing commit, per CLAUDE.md (\"Before a commit that closes a\n  ticket: post the /code-review findings... as a comment on that issue\").\n  Both runs found real bugs (crash-on-bad-input, a cascading-delete\n  footgun, a race condition) that got fixed before commit — don't skip\n  this step for T03.\n- **Commit convention**: ticket-closing commits start `T0N:` and end\n  `Closes #N`; the usage-ledger/report-notes chore commits are separate,\n  smaller commits, not bundled into the ticket commit.\n\n## Suggested skills for the next session\n\n- Call the `mattpocock-skills:domain-modeling` skill if Post's vocabulary\n  (Topic, Hot Topic, Status) needs any CONTEXT.md/ADR clarification before\n  coding — it's the skill for editing CONTEXT.md/ADRs in this repo.\n- Call the `mattpocock-skills:tdd` skill if red-green-refactor is wanted\n  for the Post state-machine logic (the spec explicitly calls for a\n  services-seam test suite with no HTTP/DB — good fit for strict TDD).\n- Call the `code-review` skill (medium effort, as a background fork) before\n  the T03 closing commit, same as T01/T02.\n- No need for `mattpocock-skills:writing-for-agents` unless CLAUDE.md\n  itself needs editing.\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d81fb187-6ab7-4eb4-ba28-98c355dff301","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Not directly relevant to Posts, but the\n  partial-unique-index trick is worth knowing if Posts need a similar\n  single-row invariant anywhere.\n- **Live preview == static publish, shared templates**: `app/routes/public.py`\n  (live, absolute URLs, reads DB directly) and `app/publish.py` (static\n  export, relative URLs, writes `site/`) both render `templates/public/page.html`\n  via `templates/public/base.html`, differing only in the href/css values\n  passed into context. When Posts reach the public site (T05, not T03),\n  follow the same pattern rather than writing a third renderer.\n- **Code review workflow**: this session ran `/code-review` (medium\n  effort) via the `code-review` skill as a background fork before each\n  ticket's closing commit, per CLAUDE.md (\"Before a commit that closes a\n  ticket: post the /code-review findings... as a comment on that issue\").\n  Both runs found real bugs (crash-on-bad-input, a cascading-delete\n  footgun, a race condition) that got fixed before commit — don't skip\n  this step for T03.\n- **Commit convention**: ticket-closing commits start `T0N:` and end\n  `Closes #N`; the usage-ledger/report-notes chore commits are separate,\n  smaller commits, not bundled into the ticket commit.\n\n## Suggested skills for the next session\n\n- Call the `mattpocock-skills:domain-modeling` skill if Post's vocabulary\n  (Topic, Hot Topic, Status) needs any CONTEXT.md/ADR clarification before\n  coding — it's the skill for editing CONTEXT.md/ADRs in this repo.\n- Call the `mattpocock-skills:tdd` skill if red-green-refactor is wanted\n  for the Post state-machine logic (the spec explicitly calls for a\n  services-seam test suite with no HTTP/DB — good fit for strict TDD).\n- Call the `code-review` skill (medium effort, as a background fork) before\n  the T03 closing commit, same as T01/T02.\n- No need for `mattpocock-skills:writing-for-agents` unless CLAUDE.md\n  itself needs editing.\n","numLines":100,"startLine":1,"totalLines":100}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f3ffd456-9bac-49d9-acce-0adaaf3ae1db","session_id":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a3824b3c-e225-4416-8b1c-2f395b014897","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}
